name: Board Release
description: Generate every board-release output in one go, into a versioned archive folder.
description_full:
One button that runs the whole release checklist: schematic PDF (all pages), PCB PDF of the copper and silkscreen layers, a complete manufacturing package (gerbers with empty layers pruned, Excellon drills, BOM.csv, positions.csv, all zipped ready to send), an interactive HTML BOM, and optional ERC/DRC reports, STEP model and source snapshot - filed into <Archive>/<Revision>/ with a manifest listing every file and its SHA-256.

Everything runs as a separate process, so nothing it does can affect KiCad. Manufacturing files come from kicad-cli directly and the assembly BOM is built in, so no fabrication plugin is needed. A built-in --doctor reports exactly why a tool failed, including which of several installed plugin copies it chose.
